verdict.rationale: EBANX documents real-time tracking of balance, scheduled payouts, and settlement history (ebanx-docs-4), and markets "unified reconciliation" for its recurring-payments solution (ebanx-docs-34). Refund records (ebanx-docs-5) and chargeback tracking (ebanx-docs-7) exist, but nothing shows them itemized inside settlement reports. missing for 10: itemized settlement/reconciliation reports breaking out fees, refunds and chargebacks; matching settlements to bank deposits; report export/API documentation; independent or hands-on corroboration.
